# Jordan Rivera
Senior Backend Engineer · Brooklyn, NY · jordan.rivera@example.com · linkedin.com/in/jordan-rivera-eng

## Summary
Senior software engineer with 7 years building distributed systems handling 1.2M req/sec. Track record of shipping production infrastructure that improves throughput, reliability, and team velocity at p99 latencies under 20ms.

## Experience

### Acme Cloud Inc — Senior Software Engineer
**Brooklyn, NY · Mar 2022 – Present**

- Shipped multi-region message broker at 1.2M req/sec, p99 18ms; cut cross-region failover from 90s to 6s
- Migrated customer-facing API from REST to gRPC, reducing payload 62% and tail latency 41%
- Built self-serve CI/CD template adopted by 38 services across 11 teams; service onboarding 4 days → 6 hours
- Mentored 4 mid-level engineers; promoted 2 to senior

### Brightline Analytics — Software Engineer
**New York, NY · Jul 2019 – Feb 2022**

- Built streaming ETL platform ingesting 4TB/day clickstream data into Snowflake
- Owned production observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry); MTTD reduced 73%
- Open-sourced `bright-rate`, Go-based distributed rate limiter (1.4k stars, used by 7 companies)
- Reduced AWS spend by $380k/yr through right-sizing and reserved-instance planning

## Skills

**Languages:** Go, Python, TypeScript, Rust, SQL
**Distributed Systems:** gRPC, Kafka, NATS, distributed tracing, Raft
**Cloud & Infra:** AWS (EC2, EKS, S3, Lambda), Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm
**Observability:** Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Honeycomb

## Education

**B.S. Computer Science** — Carnegie Mellon University (2019) · GPA 3.84
